triggeredRules.title: MonoGame.Framework assembly reference (install folder or packages folder)
triggeredRules.explanation: The project references MonoGame.Framework as an assembly with a HintPath into the installer folder or into a packages folder next to the solution. Neither exists on a clean machine, and the version is fixed by the path.
triggeredRules.resolution: The migrator replaces the reference with a PackageReference to MonoGame.Framework.DesktopGL or MonoGame.Framework.WindowsDX at 3.8.6.1, chosen from the old platform.

triggeredRules.title: MonoGamePlatform build property
triggeredRules.explanation: The project sets MonoGamePlatform, which only the old MonoGame installer targets read. It also drives the OutputPath pattern bin\$(MonoGamePlatform)\... and the platform that Content.mgcb is built for.
triggeredRules.resolution: The migrator drops the property. The target platform comes from the package that the migrated project references, and Content.mgcb gets the matching /platform.

triggeredRules.title: Windows Phone 8 project
triggeredRules.explanation: This is a Windows Phone 8 project. MonoGame 3.7 removed Windows Phone 8.1 support and the content builder no longer accepts the WindowsPhone8 platform.
triggeredRules.resolution: The project is copied unchanged and listed as manual work (monogame-upgrade task 14.1). Move the shared game code to a desktop project.

triggeredRules.title: OUYA, PlayStation Mobile or PS Vita project
triggeredRules.explanation: This project targets a platform that MonoGame no longer supports: OUYA (removed in 3.6), PlayStation Mobile (removed in 3.5) or PS Vita (removed in 3.8.1).
triggeredRules.resolution: The project is copied unchanged and listed as manual work (monogame-upgrade task 14.1). Move the shared game code to a desktop project.

triggeredRules.title: Content.mgcb platform is not valid for the 3.8.6.1 desktop targets
triggeredRules.explanation: Content.mgcb is built for a platform that the 3.8.6.1 content builder does not accept or that is not a desktop target (WindowsStoreApp, WindowsPhone8, PlayStationMobile and PSVita were removed; MacOSX, NativeClient and RaspberryPi are not targets of the migrated copy).
triggeredRules.resolution: The migrator sets /platform to the platform of the chosen desktop target (Windows or DesktopGL).
